prompt:

reference analysis. Read the source and both screenshots. Evaluate taste, useful
interaction, accessibility risks, truthful provenance and unnecessary complexity.
Identify a few consequential findings with source/line or visible evidence.

browser. Do not claim runtime or accessibility verification from screenshots.

without machine-specific absolute paths. Be candid about whether it looks good.
scope: Explicit artwork-field source, design direction, source analysis and two screenshots. No browser interaction by reviewer.
